name: PotatoVoxel (Beta)
description: PotatoVoxel (fork of Dramatic Shape): an unconditional Brick-mode 3D voxel overworld for low-end devices. VOXEL OFF / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW / POTATO preserve the supported render scales, mesh cache and prebuild; HIGH uses the two-layer 1536px shadow map and lower active modes use contact shadows.
